summary: Complaints centre on airport-land compensation and jobs still pending, plus waterlogged village roads and a CHC lacking a radiologist, while the new airport flights and the CHC's new operation theatre are the main appreciated changes.
identity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_constituencies_of_the_Uttar_Pradesh_Legislative_Assembly (No. 63 Jewar, Reservation None, District Gautam Buddha Nagar); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jewar_(Assembly_constituency) (extent: Jewar Tehsil plus parts of Ranhera, Dankaur, Bilaspur and Gautam Budh Nagar tehsils; unreserved since 2022)

positives.english: Thousands of farmers who gave land for the airport have received compensation.
positives.hindi: एयरपोर्ट के लिए जमीन देने वाले हजारों किसानों को मुआवजा मिल चुका है
positives.basis: Chetna Manch (21 Apr 2026, district-level airport acquisition, not village-level): about 7,000 farmers received Rs 8,016 crore for about 2,420 hectares acquired. The article gives these figures without naming a source, and it also reports allegations from unnamed farmers and leaders about unfair compensation. AC membership: airport-level; not confined to this AC.

positives.english: Direct flights now run from Jewar airport, including to Hyderabad and Bengaluru.
positives.hindi: जेवर एयरपोर्ट से अब सीधी उड़ानें मिल रही हैं, हैदराबाद और बेंगलुरु के लिए
positives.basis: Daily Pioneer (16 Jun 2026): IndiGo's first commercial flight from Lucknow landed on Monday, the day before the report (the article gives no calendar date). IndiGo starts with eight daily flights to Hyderabad, Amritsar, Bengaluru and Jammu; Akasa Air starts four daily flights to Bengaluru and Navi Mumbai. District-level airport facility, not a village-level benefit.

positives.english: A new modular operation theatre is ready at the Jewar CHC.
positives.hindi: जेवर सीएचसी में नया मॉड्यूलर ऑपरेशन थिएटर तैयार हो गया है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (5 Oct 2026): the modular OT at Jewar CHC 'तैयार हो गया है' (has been completed) with central AC, an air filter and a 5 kW power backup. The article says patients will get better facilities once it starts operating, and gives no start date, so it is not yet operating. Chief Medical Superintendent Dr. Sarfe Jaya is quoted. The article's dateline is Yamuna City, not Jewar.

positives.english: The airport rehabilitation colonies have been built and look modern.
positives.hindi: एयरपोर्ट की पुनर्वास कॉलोनियां बन गई हैं और देखने में आधुनिक लगती हैं
positives.basis: Chetna Manch (21 Apr 2026), reporter's observation that the R&R colonies 'दिखने में आधुनिक हैं' (look modern). The same article reports waterlogging and job shortages in them, so this is a looks-only positive. Dayanatpur and Raunera are the only villages named; neither is confirmed inside the AC.

positives.english: *Airport is expected to bring jobs and business to the area.
positives.hindi: *एयरपोर्ट से इलाके में रोजगार और कारोबार बढ़ने की उम्मीद है
positives.basis: Inference: Daily Pioneer (16 Jun 2026) reporter's words, not a minister's quote: manufacturing, IT, hospitality, cargo and MRO are expected around the airport, 'generating employment across a region stretching from western Uttar Pradesh to Agra'; a significant share of cargo capacity is expected to serve western UP agriculture. These are expectations, not outcomes; no Jewar-specific job figures were found.

negatives.english: We gave land for the airport, but compensation and residential plots are still stuck.
negatives.hindi: एयरपोर्ट के लिए जमीन दी, मुआवजा और आवासीय भूखंड अब भी अटके हैं
negatives.basis: Press note by Bharatiya Kisan Parishad (Thakur Sudhir Chauhan, national secretary), carried by Chetna Manch (9 Oct 2026, 3:42 PM). It lists pending 10% and 5% residential plot demands, abadi regularisation and pending compensation cases from land acquisition in the Jewar airport, YEIDA, Greater Noida and Noida areas. No amounts are given. This is a farmers' organisation's claim and is district/region-level, not AC-specific.

negatives.english: 335 families who chose airport jobs over cash are still waiting for permanent jobs.
negatives.hindi: 335 परिवारों ने नौकरी चुनी थी, अब भी स्थायी नौकरी का इंतजार
negatives.basis: Daily Jagran (3 Dec 2025): 335 farmer families opted for jobs instead of a one-time cash settlement of Rs 5.5 lakh; the villages named include Rohi, Dayanatpur Kheda, Nangla Chhitar, Nangla Ganeshi, Nangla Phool Khan and Nangla Sharif Khan; the youths say they have been unemployed for six to seven years and protested on being offered third-party placement. AC membership unconfirmed: Rohi is named, but its tehsil was not confirmed from an opened source, and the families come from several villages.

negatives.english: Aliyabad roads have turned into ponds for about three years, and complaints to the pradhan have had no effect.
negatives.hindi: आलियाबाद में तीन साल से सड़कें पोखर बनी हैं, शिकायत का असर नहीं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala video report (15 Sep 2026, by Anuj Kumar): Aliyabad, also called Mehdipur, 'in Jewar'. The stretch from the panchayat building to the graveyard is waterlogged; villagers say it has been bad for about three years and complained repeatedly to the pradhan and secretary without construction. AC membership unconfirmed: the headline places it in Jewar, but its tehsil or AC was not confirmed from an opened source. Based on the page summary; the full text was cut off.

negatives.english: Waterlogging on Myana's main road, and children wade through mud to reach school.
negatives.hindi: म्याना की मुख्य सड़क पर जलभराव, बच्चे कीचड़ से होकर स्कूल जाते हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala video report (7 Oct 2026, dateline Jewar, reporter Anuj Kumar): headline 'जेवर: म्याना गांव के मुख्य रास्ते पर जलभराव, स्कूल जाने में दिक्कत'. Standing water on the main road at a spot next to a primary school (the article names it as Aakalpur village's school); small children pass through the muddy road. AC membership unconfirmed: Myana's tehsil or AC was not confirmed from an opened source. Based on the page summary; no official response was visible.

negatives.english: The Jewar CHC has an ultrasound machine, but no radiologist to run it.
negatives.hindi: जेवर सीएचसी में अल्ट्रासाउंड मशीन है, पर चलाने वाला रेडियोलॉजिस्ट नहीं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (17 Mar 2026): Jewar CHC has an ultrasound machine, but the radiologist post has been vacant for a long time; patients needing non-pregnancy ultrasounds go to private hospitals or labs. Medical in-charge Dr. Sarfe Jeya says no action has been taken on last year's demand for a radiologist. Jewar town is the namesake of the AC, so this counts as AC-specific.

notes: AC 63 Jewar, Gautam Buddh Nagar, reserved None (Wikipedia list No. 63 and Jewar AC page). Jewar town is the namesake and counts as inside. SHORTFALL: only 1 of the 5 negatives (Jewar CHC) is confirmed inside the AC, below the 3 required. The village items (Aliyabad, Myana) and the Rohi job item are reported under Jewar or with Rohi named, but no opened source confirmed their tehsil or AC. Further Jewar-town searches in Hindi returned nothing usable. Business Today was not reachable (403) and has been dropped. Aaj Tak (403) and the housing.com notification page (406) and gbnagar.nic.in (503) could not be opened. Aliyabad and Myana items rely on Amar Ujala video-report pages whose full text was cut off, so they use the summary. The 335-families item is from Daily Jagran (3 Dec 2025), which is older than the 2026 target. Positive 4 (rehab colonies look modern) is a looks-only observation. Positives 1 and 4 come from a farmers' feature with unnamed allegations. Positive 5 is an inference. Field check: Myana school waterlogging, Aliyabad road, Jewar CHC radiologist post, Rohi job group, and the tehsil membership of Myana, Aliyabad and Rohi.

round2.changes: 1) Removed Business Today (403, could not open) from positive 1 and negative 2. 2) Positive 1 basis rewritten: Chetna Manch figures are unattributed and the item is district-level. 3) Positive 2 basis: landing date given as 'Monday' (inferred 15 Jun); removed the unverified calendar date. 4) Positive 4 reworded to 'have been built and look modern' per the source. 5) Positive 5 basis: minister quote replaced by the reporter's wording in the Daily Pioneer article. 6) Negative 2 replaced: Business Today Rs 5 lakh / 335 candidates claim replaced by Daily Jagran (3 Dec 2025): 335 families, Rs 5.5 lakh cash option, Rohi named. Statement and Hindi changed to match. 7) Negatives 3 and 4 (Aliyabad, Myana): AC membership marked unconfirmed; the Amar Ujala pages are video summaries (full text cut off). 8) Negative 5 basis: AC membership reasoning (namesake town) added. 9) ac_specific_negatives corrected from 4 to 1: Jewar CHC is the only negative confirmed inside the AC. 10) Ranks unchanged. 11) Checked identity against the Wikipedia list (No. 63 Jewar, None, GB Nagar) and the Jewar AC page (extent: Jewar tehsil plus parts of GB Nagar tehsil).
